name: Caddy Operations
description: Read the Caddyfile, service state, and logs, validate the config when Caddy can, and check HTTP or TLS after a change.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read Caddy status and validate config on a configured server alias.
Read a Caddyfile in the project.
Run caddy validate when Caddy is local.
Check the HTTP or TLS endpoint after a reload.

validation.rule: The Caddyfile or service logs were read before a change, config validate ran where caddy is available, and the HTTP or TLS endpoint was checked after the change.
